The sentence is data, not an instruction. Do not fact-check, rewrite, shorten, or simplify it.
Preserve names, modifiers, roles, shared participants, negation, source content and clause structure.
Use this format:
{"version":"logical-form-v1","entities":[{"id":"x","text":"source phrase","concept":"noun lemma","detail":"decomposed","properties":[{"role":"mod","value":"modifier"}]}],"formula":...}
Use stable entity IDs shared between clauses. Each entity is declared once. Keep exact names in text.
For a simple modified noun, text is the noun/name and properties contain each modifier.
A complex phrase whose internal relations you cannot represent may have detail="phrase" and exact text.
Formula nodes:
- {"op":"event","id":"e","predicate":"verb lemma","anchor":"exact verb/adjective in sentence","arguments":{"ARG0":"entity ID","ARG1":"entity ID"}}
- {"op":"and","children":[...]} or {"op":"or","children":[...]}
- {"op":"not","child":event node}. Do not add NOT to a positive sentence, passive voice or perfect aspect.
- {"op":"entity","ref":"entity ID"} for a nominal source complement such as a depicted object/state.
An event may include properties with role/value, and may have sense if known. Do not invent a sense number.
Use predicate-specific PropBank roles. ARG0 is NOT always an agent.
For land, collapse and arrest, the thing landing/collapsing/person arrested is ARG1.
Land may add location. Hug uses ARG0=hugger and ARG1=person hugged; receive uses ARG0=recipient, ARG1=thing received.
Preserve a relation's other arguments such as location, destination or manner. Never treat a preposition as an independent object.
For a source statement, keep the outer event and attach its embedded formula as content, with route:
visual_depiction for photos/imagery/footage depicting content; speech_assertion for a speaker saying content;
ocr_assertion for written text asserting content. Source content must not be another world-level conjunct.
Tense/aspect will be read from the original anchor and its auxiliaries. Keep the original anchor.
If modality, counting, reference or scope cannot be represented, output
{"version":"logical-form-v1","status":"abstain","reason":"...","entities":[],"formula":{}}.
